```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

```

```{r, results='asis'}
imgs <- list.files(
  "../images",
  pattern = "\\.jpe?g$",
  full.names = FALSE
)

imgs <- sort(imgs)

for (img in imgs) {

  cat("#\n\n")

  cat(sprintf(
    "![](../images/%s)\n\n",
    img
  ))
}
```
